privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: Binderbound is a free fan project with no ads and no trackers. Here is exactly what it stores, why, and how you stay in control of your data (GDPR).

sections.title: Data controller
sections.body: Binderbound is published by Hugo, as a personal, non-commercial project, who is the controller of your data. Contact: {{email}}.

sections.title: Without an account
sections.body: You can use Binderbound without an account. Your collection, language and sound setting then stay in your browser (local storage): nothing is sent to the server.

sections.title: Account data
sections.body: If you create an account, we store your email address, your name and, depending on how you sign in, your password in hashed form (never in plain text) or your Google ID with your profile picture. We also store your saved binders and the cards you have checked.

sections.title: Friends and trades
sections.body: If you use trades, we store your friends, the cards you mark as spares and your trade offers (cards, note, status). A random friend code lets people add you without ever seeing your email address. Your friends, and only them, can see your name, profile picture, the cards you own and your spares in a trade’s set; removing a friend revokes this access.

sections.title: Sign in with Google
sections.body: With “Sign in with Google”, Google only shares your name, email address and profile picture with us. We have no access to anything else in your Google account.

sections.title: Purpose and legal basis
sections.body: This data is only used to run your account: signing you in and saving your binders and collection, trading with your friends. Processing is based on providing the service you request by creating an account (GDPR article 6.1.b). No automated decision-making and no profiling.

sections.title: Retention
sections.body: Your data is kept for as long as your account exists. A session expires after 30 days. If you delete your account, everything is erased immediately and permanently.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.body: A single, strictly necessary cookie keeps you signed in, so it does not require consent. There are no advertising cookies and no analytics.

sections.title: Recipients and hosting
sections.body: Your data is never sold, shared (beyond what friends you accepted can see) or used for advertising. It is hosted by OVHcloud (OVH SAS, France). Card images are loaded from Riot Games’ servers and the Google button from Google’s: like any website, they receive your IP address.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You have the rights of access, rectification, erasure, portability, restriction and objection. Once signed in, you can download all your data or delete your account yourself at the bottom of this page. For anything else, write to {{email}}: we reply within 30 days. You can also lodge a complaint with your data protection authority (in France, the CNIL: cnil.fr).

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.lead: The ground rules for using Binderbound, and the site’s legal notice.

sections.title: Legal notice
sections.body: Publisher: Hugo, private individual, non-commercial. Contact: {{email}}. Host: OVH SAS, 2 rue Kellermann, 59100 Roubaix, France (ovhcloud.com).

sections.title: Purpose
sections.body: Binderbound is a free tool that tells you where to file Riftbound cards in a binder. Using the site means you accept these terms.

sections.title: Access
sections.body: The service is free and usable without an account. It comes with no availability guarantee: it may be interrupted, changed or discontinued at any time, for example for maintenance.

sections.title: Account
sections.body: An account is optional. You agree to provide accurate information and keep your password confidential; you are responsible for activity on your account. You can delete it at any time from the Privacy page. An account used abusively may be suspended or deleted.

sections.title: Acceptable use
sections.body: You must not try to compromise the site’s security or operation, access other people’s data, send automated requests in bulk, or use the service commercially without prior agreement.

sections.title: Trades between friends
sections.body: Binderbound lets friends propose card trades, with no money involved. The site only records offers and updates collections: the actual exchange of cards happens between players, under their sole responsibility. Prices shown are indicative (Card Nexus, TCGplayer converted to euros) and are not an offer.

sections.title: Intellectual property
sections.body: Binderbound was created under Riot Games’ “Legal Jibber Jabber” policy using assets owned by Riot Games; Riot Games does not endorse or sponsor this project. Riftbound, League of Legends and the card artwork are the property of Riot Games, Inc. Card data comes from Riftcodex, an unofficial community project. Binderbound’s code and design belong to its publisher.

sections.title: Liability
sections.body: Information is provided as is. Card data may contain errors or omissions: double-check before filing a valuable card. The publisher cannot be held liable for any damage arising from use of the site or its unavailability.

sections.title: Personal data
sections.body: How your data is processed is described on the Privacy page.

sections.title: Changes
sections.body: These terms may change; the last update date appears at the bottom of the page. Continuing to use the site after a change means you accept the new version.

sections.title: Governing law
sections.body: These terms are governed by French law. In case of dispute, an amicable solution will be sought first; failing that, the French courts will have jurisdiction.
